evidence.note: Dozens of thin (~1 px) light-grey lines fan from small agent-run dots into the package mirror; the lines are faint hairlines and the dots are small outlined circles.
At the small viewer size the fan of grey hairlines and tiny dots becomes a faint grey haze; the 'PUBLIC INTERNET' label is very pale grey small caps on paper, barely legible.
'PUBLIC INTERNET' zone label and the thin-outline globe and arrow are low-contrast grey; the public-internet zone fill is nearly indistinguishable from the background.
Title, timeline text and quote card use generous, high-contrast type; no paper texture or grain anywhere.

rationale: The type in the title, timeline and cards is large and clear and there is no texture, but the core diagram relies on a fan of 1 px grey hairlines and small thin-outlined dots that compression would smear away. The 'PUBLIC INTERNET' label and globe are small faint grey, which fits the fail descriptor's 'small faint text' and hairlines.
